system.description:
Deal [STR base]  direct damage. This damage activates one stack of [Pursuit] as if the target had failed a [Dodge Check]. 

(SR 2): You can [Normal Move] up to 1 Sq before the effect is exerted. However, you can not move when you are in [Rigor] state. 
(SR 3): The moving distance is increased up to 2 Sq.

A special skill that strikes the enemy with the guard or handle of the weapon. It can also be used for restraint while closing the gap.
